leanne-choi: Heads-up 1: RetailCloud wants a 3-week POC to validate retrieval+QA for customer support docs. Key asks: p95 latency <=350ms, steady 30 QPS, cost goal <$0.40/1k tokens, and >88% accuracy on their labeled intent set.
devon-park: Quick constraints: their data residency + no retention pushes them to Dedicated or Private. We should scope Dedicated first and offer Private as a follow-up.
nina-ortiz: For eval set I propose 120 prompts: 60 product questions, 40 billing, 20 escalation scenarios. They need per-prompt expected answer for binary pass/fail.
devon-park: Latency reality check 1: hosted opt-13b-quant at 30 QPS with caching might hit p95 ~420ms for 512 token seq. Options: (A) Dedicated quant-12B with tuned kernels (p95 ~300-380ms) or (B) 8B low-latency family (p95 ~200-280ms) but risk ~1-3% quality drop.
leanne-choi: Sales ask: include cost sensitivity and a rollback plan if quality doesn't meet threshold. Also need SSO + customer KMS on contract.
infra-bot: dedicated-provision request accepted. cluster-name: retailcloud-poc. ETA 28h.
devon-park: Test plan: run A/B at 70/30 split, collect latency histograms, token breakdown, and quality pass rates. We'll run daily load tests to simulate 30 QPS burst windows.
nina-ortiz: Acceptance gates I'm proposing: 1) Quality >=88% across combined prompt suite; 2) Latency p95 <=380ms on their typical seq length distribution; 3) Error rate <1.5%; 4) Cost within 25% of estimate.
leanne-choi: Who owns what?
devon-park: I'll own model selection, quant profiles, and routing/fallback policy. I'll add a fallback to 8B if p95 spikes >500ms but mark such requests for review.
nina-ortiz: I'll produce the prompt set + annotate ground truth. Need two SME reviewers from customer. Also will run semantic-similarity drift checks weekly.
leanne-choi: I'll handle pricing memo and customer comms. Preparing a short one-pager with burn estimates.
legal: Please send the KMS + data retention clause. We'll reply with updated DPA within 48 hours.
devon-park: perf snippet for kickoff:
```
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-8b-lowlat","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize support ticket and extract intent"}]}'
```
leanne-choi: Timeline: week0 kickoff; week1 prompt labeling + baseline runs; week2 A/B perf + focused tuning; week3 acceptance demo + handoff.
nina-ortiz: If quality misses by 3-5pts, propose targeted prompt engineering + 1-week extension to retest. If cost is >25% over estimate, escalate to pricing for override.
leanne-choi: I'll book kickoff for Tue 9am PT and share the runbook. tagging @legal and @devon-park for ASAP inputs. :thumbsup:
legal: Acknowledged. Will review KMS language and return comments.
